children: Latigo Biotherapeutics, Inc. reported results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, posting a net loss attributable to common stockholders of $(25.8M) for 2Q 2026, essentially flat with the year‑ago quarter, and diluted net loss per share of $(27.59). The company remains pre‑revenue for the periods presented.
Net income: Net loss attributable to common stockholders of $(25.8M) for 2Q 2026, versus $(25.8M) in the year‑ago quarter — essentially flat YoY.
Diluted EPS: Diluted net loss per share $(27.59) for 2Q 2026, versus $(36.52) in the year‑ago quarter.
Revenue: No product revenue; company remains pre‑revenue for the periods presented.
Clinical milestone: A pivotal abdominoplasty trial for onzotrigine met primary and key secondary endpoints versus placebo and an opioid comparator.
Pipeline progress: Initiation planned for a Phase 3 bunionectomy trial and an open‑label Phase 3 safety study for onzotrigine H2H in H2/2026; topline data expected in H2/2027.
Next‑gen programs: LTG‑321 Phase 2 proof‑of‑concept in knee osteoarthritis is underway, with a CPT biomarker translated to clinical endpoints and toplines due H2/2027.
Commercial and manufacturing prep: CMC manufacturing and stability plans for onzotrigine have been discussed with the FDA; IV formulation work is underway to support hospital use.
Operations: Headcount and G&A have increased to support public‑company operations and expanded clinical programs; cash runway is projected into 2029.
